CENTRAL Station.
July 24 1923
REPORT ON "New Shanghai Life"
Made by D. I. Sullivan Forwarded by [Signature]
Sir,
The General Manager of the Russian newspaper
"New Shanghai Life", the offices of which are at 12 Boone
Road, is Nicolas Eugene Doenin who lives at 55 Bubbling
Well Road. The Editors are David Rabinovitch and Vladimir
Nesbadva who reside at 28 Chaoufoong Road and 3 Boundary
Terrace respectively. Rabinovitch states that he and
Nesbadva are jointly responsible for what appears in the
paper. As regards the article which appeared in the
"New Shanghai Life" on July 22, Rabinovitch states that
it is a translation from the "North China Daily News"
of July 21. The Police translator says the articles are
identical. "North China Daily News" attached.
※ See also
S.B - D. 1970.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
D. I.
M
D. O. I.

1923年7月24日
中央巡捕房。
1923年7月24日
关于《新上海生活》的报告
由 D. I. Sullivan 呈报，经 [签名] 转呈
先生，
俄文报纸《新上海生活》的总经理是 Nicolas Eugene Doenin，该报社位于布恩路（Boone Road）12号，他本人居住在静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）55号。编辑为 David Rabinovitch 和 Vladimir Nesbadva，分别居住在赵丰路（Chaoufoong Road）28号和边界台（Boundary Terrace）28号。Rabinovitch 称，他和 Nesbadva 共同对报纸刊登的内容负责。关于7月22日《新上海生活》上刊登的文章，Rabinovitch 称该文译自7月21日的《字林西报》。警方翻译人员表示两篇文章内容一致。附《字林西报》剪报。
※ 另见
S.B - D. 1970.
先生，
您忠实的仆人，
[签名]
D. I.

Appeal of the Chinese Communistic Party.
We have received a copy of the Manifesto, issued by the
General Executive Committee of the Chinese Communistic party
in connection with the present political events in China. We
here with reproduce its contents.
American Imperialism and the Peking Coup d'etat. As a result
of a brief review of political events in China and the recent
coup d'etat, effected by Tsao-Kun, which ended in the over-
throw of Li-Yuan-Hun, the Committee comes to the following
conclusions: that the coup d'etat was carried out with the
assistance of American diplomats and the American adherent, the
"Christian General" Feng-Yu-Hsing. Having been supporting this
diplomatic party Tsao-Kun expected to receive financial assis-
tance from America and that is why he dared to expel Li-Yuan-
Hung. Thus as a result of the coup d'etat victory went to
American imperialism. The expected activities of the Anfu
party will also bring nothing good, but will do harm to China.
Both the Anfu and the Chilli parties are being supported by
imperialists. Therefore the victory of either of these will
not benefit China and will not be recognized by the Chinese
people as such.
Parliament. Touching on the question of Parliament, the
Manifesto states that the shameful, mercenary and covetous
M.P's. have long been maintained by Tsao-Kun. Are there amongst
them a few honest men? And if there are why don't they come
forward? asks the Manifesto. All student, labour and commercial
organizations are protesting against the usurpation by the M.P's
of the right to represent the People's will and interests. What
and what section of the Chinese people does this Parliament
represent? The suggestion to transfer its sessions to the
South, is contrary to the real desire of the People. Even
though "Parliament" does work out a Constitution and elects
a new President, the Chinese people will have to proclaim
aloud that they do not recognize the force or lawfulness of
those decisions.
Tuchuns in the South. The Manifesto continues: "The South-
Western Generals have also appeared on the political stage in
order to obtain their share of the booty. These generals main-
tain large armies to suppress the people's rights and to
acquire riches and are no better than the Chilli militarists.
Nominally they declare their desire to institute a Federation
of Autonomic Provinces, but in reality they are aiming to form
a Federation of Tuchuns".
No agreements whatever with the militarists and the imperia-
lists. The Manifesto further appeals for the formation of a
Revolutionary Government and to struggle for independence. For
this purpose the united efforts of the whole of the people and
large and heavy sacrifices will be necessary.
"We cannot follow the example of the Korean nationalists, who
insist on the recognition of the Treaty of Versailles and the
Washington Conference, as a result of which they hope to attain
their desires", state the Manifesto. "We hate the Chinese
militarists who are working for their own benefit with the
assistance of the foreign Powers and foreign imperialists. Many
who hate militarism seek support from the foreign Powers. But
the people who do not understand the close relationship and
connection between the militarists and foreign imperialists,
cannot form an independent autonomy State. In opposition to
this we demand a Government, formed by the efforts of the People

“上海
生活”
第 7 期，第 25 页。
中国共产党宣言。
我们收到了一份由中国共产党总执行委员会就中国当前政治事件发布的宣言副本。兹将其内容转载如下。
美帝国主义与北京政变。在简要回顾了中国政治事件及最近由曹锟发动、导致黎元洪被推翻的政变后，委员会得出以下结论：此次政变是在美国外交官及其追随者、“基督将军”冯玉祥的协助下进行的。曹锟支持这一外交派系，期望从美国获得财政援助，因此才敢于驱逐黎元洪。因此，政变的结果是美帝国主义取得了胜利。预期安福派的活动也不会带来任何好处，反而会对中国造成损害。安福派和直系均受到帝国主义者的支持。因此，无论哪一方获胜，都不会造福中国，也不会被中国人民所承认。
国会。关于国会问题，宣言指出，那些可耻、唯利是图且贪婪的议员长期由曹锟豢养。他们当中是否有几个诚实的人？如果有，他们为何不站出来？宣言问道。所有学生、劳工和商业组织都在抗议议员篡夺代表人民意志和利益的权利。这个国会代表谁以及中国人民的哪个阶层？将会议地点迁往南方的建议，违背了人民的真实愿望。即使“国会”制定了宪法并选举出新总统，中国人民也必须大声宣告，他们不承认这些决定的效力或合法性。
南方的督军。宣言继续说道：“西南将领也登上政治舞台，以分得一杯羹。这些将领维持庞大的军队以压制人民权利并攫取财富，与直系军阀并无二致。名义上，他们宣称希望建立联省自治，但实际上旨在形成‘督军联合会’。”
绝不与军阀和帝国主义者达成任何协议。宣言进一步呼吁组建革命政府并为独立而斗争。为此，需要全体人民的共同努力以及巨大的牺牲。
宣言称：“我们不能效仿韩国民族主义者，他们坚持要求承认《凡尔赛条约》和华盛顿会议，希望能借此实现其愿望。”“我们痛恨那些在外国列强和外国帝国主义者协助下为一己私利行事的中国军阀。许多憎恨军阀主义的人寻求外国列强的支持。但是，不了解军阀与外国帝国主义者之间密切关系和联系的人，无法建立独立的自治国家。与此相反，我们要求一个仅由人民努力组成的政府

People cannot recognize a Government organized and controlled
by any of the imperialistic foreign countries.
National Congress. The Manifesto in conclusion appeals to
the people to oppose Tsao-kun. It, moreover, insists on the
Convocation of a National Congress consisting of representa-
tives of Chambers of Commerce, Agricultural Unions, Student
organizations and Professional labour unions of the whole
country, also of the Chinese Communist party. The Congress
must solve the following problems: the Constitution, the
unification of the country and the formation of a new Chinese
Government.
"Anew Government, born of the National Congress, being a
really national revolutionary authority will be able to
destroy militaristic power throughout China, as well as the
foreign imperialists hiding behind it. The new Government
will not be a local authority or a Government co-operating
with foreign imperialists, but a true People's Government.
Brethren, this is the only possible way to save China from
double oppression at the hands of the militarists and the
foreign Powers!
"Down with the imperialistic Powers, who make use of
militarists in their exploitation of China! Down with the
militarists who assist foreign Powers to oppress the Chinese
People!
"Nationalistic revolutionaries of the whole of China,
Unite!"

Publishing Co-operative Society.
A Publishing Co-operative Society is being organized in
the Far East at the initiative of "Centrosoyus". Three
organizations will be included in the Society viz: "Centrosoyus",
"DalBank" (the Far Eastern Bank) and "Gosizdaga" (State Book).
The purpose of this organization is to distribute on a
large scale books to villages.
To the peasant population in general, and to the teaching
profession in particular the Publishing Co-operative Society
will allow about four months' credit.
The Co-operative Society will supply villages with old
and new literature, study books etc.

俄文报纸摘录译文。

一个诞生于革命的政府，因为人民不能承认由任何帝国主义外国组织控制的政府。
国民大会。宣言最后呼吁人民反对曹锟。此外，它坚持召开由全国商会、农会、学生组织和职业工会以及中国共产党的代表组成的国民大会。大会必须解决以下问题：宪法、国家统一和新中国政府的组建。
“一个诞生于国民大会的新政府，作为真正的民族革命权威，将能够摧毁遍布中国的军阀势力，以及隐藏在其背后的外国帝国主义者。新政府不会是地方当局，也不会是与外国帝国主义者合作的政府，而是一个真正的人民政府。
同胞们，这是使中国免于遭受军阀和外国列强双重压迫的唯一可行途径！
“打倒利用军阀剥削中国的帝国主义列强！打倒协助外国列强压迫中国人民的军阀！
“全中国的民族革命者，联合起来！”

出版合作社。
在“中央消费合作总社”（Centrosoyus）的倡议下，远东地区正在组建一个出版合作社。该社将包括三个组织，即：“中央消费合作总社”、“远东银行”（DalBank）和“国家出版社”（Gosizdaga）。该组织的目的是向农村地区大规模分发书籍。
出版合作社将向广大农民群体，特别是教师群体，提供约四个月的赊销期限。
合作社将向村庄供应新旧文学作品、学习用书等。

Appeal of the Chinese Communist Party.

We have received a copy of the Manifesto, issued by the General Executive Committee of the Chinese Communistic Party, in connection with the present political events in China. We herewith reproduce its contents:
American Imperialism and the Peking Coup d'etat. As a result of a brief review of political events in China and the recent coup d'etat, effected by Tsao Kun, which ended in the overthrowal of Li-Yuan-Hung, the Committee comes to the following conclusion: that the coup d'etat was carried out with the assistance of American diplomats and the American adherent, the "Christian General" Feng-Yu-sing. Having been supporting this diplomatic party, Tsao Kun expected to receive financial assistance from America and that is why he dared to expel Li-Yuan Hung. Thus as a result of the coup d'etat victory went to American imperialism. The expected activities of the Anfu party will also bring nothing good, but will do harm to China. Both the Anfu and the Chili parties are being supported by imperialists. Therefore, the victory of either of these will not benefit China and will not be recognized by the Chinese people as such.
Parliament. Touching on the question of Parliament, the Manifesto states that the shameful, mercenary and covetous M.P's have long been maintained by Tsao-Kun. Are there amongst them a few honest men? And if there are why don't they come forward? asks the Manifesto. All student, labour and commercial organizations are protesting against the usurpation by the M.P's of the right to represent the People's will and interests. Who and what section of the Chinese people does this Parliament represent? The suggestion to transfer its sessions to the South, is contrary to the real desire of the People. Even though "Parliament" does work out a Constitution and elects a new President, the Chinese people will have to proclaim aloud that they do not recognize the force or lawfulness of these decisions.
Tuchuns in the South. The Manifesto continues: "The South-Western Generals have also appeared on the political stage in order to obtain their share of the booty. These Generals maintain large armies to suppress the people's rights and to acquire riches and are no better than the Chili militarists. Nominally they declare their desire to institute a Federation of Autonomic Provinces, but in reality they are aiming to form a Federation of Tuchuns."
No agreements whatever with the militarists and the imperialists!
The Manifesto further appeals for the formation of a Revolutionary Government and to struggle for independence. For this purpose the united efforts of the whole of the people and large and heavy sacrifices will be necessary.
"We cannot follow the example of the Korean nationalists, who insist on the recognition of the Treaty of Versailles and the Washington Conference, as a result of which they hope to attain their desires, states the Manifesto. "We hate the Chinese militarists who are working for their own benefit with the assistance of the foreign Powers and foreign imperialists. Many who hate militarists, seek support from the foreign Powers. But the people who do not understand the close relationship and connection between the militarists and foreign imperialists, cannot form an independent autonomy State. In opposition to this we demand a Government, formed by the efforts of the People alone, a Government born of the Revolution, because the People cannot recognize a Government organized and controlled by any of the imperialistic foreign countries.
National Congress. The Manifesto, in conclusion appeals to the people to oppose Tsao-Kun. It, moreover, insists on the Convention of a National Congress consisting of representatives of Chambers of Commerce, Agricultural Unions, Student organizations and Professional Labour Unions of the whole country, also of the Chinese Communist party. The Congress must solve the following problems: the Constitution, the unification of the country and the formation of a new Chinese Government.
"A new Government, born of the National Congress, being a really national revolutionary authority will be able to destroy militaristic power throughout China, as well as the foreign imperialists hiding behind it. The new Government will not be a local authority or a Government co-operating with foreign imperialists, but a true People's Government.
Brethren, this is the only possible way to save China from double oppression at the hands of the militarists and the foreign Powers. "Down with the imperialistic Powers, who make use of militarists in their exploitation of China! "Down with the militarists who assist foreign Powers to oppress the Chinese people! "Nationalistic revolutionaries of the whole masses of China, Unite!"

中国共产党宣言。

我们收到了一份由中国共产党总执行委员会就中国当前政治事件发布的宣言副本。兹将其内容转载如下：
美帝国主义与北京政变。在简要回顾了中国政治事件及最近由曹锟发动、导致黎元洪被推翻的政变后，委员会得出以下结论：此次政变是在美国外交官及其追随者、“基督将军”冯玉祥的协助下进行的。曹锟支持这一外交派系，期望从美国获得财政援助，因此才敢于驱逐黎元洪。因此，政变的结果是美帝国主义取得了胜利。预期安福派的活动也不会带来任何好处，反而会对中国造成损害。安福派和直系均受到帝国主义者的支持。因此，无论哪一方获胜，都不会造福中国，也不会被中国人民所承认。
国会。关于国会问题，宣言指出，那些可耻、唯利是图且贪婪的议员长期由曹锟豢养。他们当中是否有几个诚实的人？如果有，他们为何不站出来？宣言问道。所有学生、劳工和商业组织都在抗议议员篡夺代表人民意志和利益的权利。这个国会代表谁以及中国人民的哪个阶层？将会议地点迁往南方的建议，违背了人民的真实愿望。即使“国会”制定了宪法并选举出新总统，中国人民也必须大声宣告，他们不承认这些决定的效力或合法性。
南方的督军。宣言继续说道：“西南将领也登上政治舞台，以分得一杯羹。这些将领维持庞大的军队以压制人民权利并攫取财富，与直系军阀并无二致。名义上，他们宣称希望建立联省自治，但实际上旨在形成‘督军联合会’。”
绝不与军阀和帝国主义者达成任何协议！
宣言进一步呼吁组建革命政府并为独立而斗争。为此，需要全体人民的共同努力以及巨大的牺牲。
宣言称：“我们不能效仿韩国民族主义者，他们坚持要求承认《凡尔赛条约》和华盛顿会议，希望能借此实现其愿望。”“我们痛恨那些在外国列强和外国帝国主义者协助下为一己私利行事的中国军阀。许多憎恨军阀主义的人寻求外国列强的支持。但是，不了解军阀与外国帝国主义者之间密切关系和联系的人，无法建立独立的自治国家。与此相反，我们要求一个仅由人民努力组成的政府，一个诞生于革命的政府，因为人民不能承认由任何帝国主义外国组织控制的政府。
国民大会。宣言最后呼吁人民反对曹锟。此外，它坚持召开由全国商会、农会、学生组织和职业工会以及中国共产党的代表组成的国民大会。大会必须解决以下问题：宪法、国家统一和新中国政府的组建。
“一个诞生于国民大会的新政府，作为真正的民族革命权威，将能够摧毁遍布中国的军阀势力，以及隐藏在其背后的外国帝国主义者。新政府不会是地方当局，也不会是与外国帝国主义者合作的政府，而是一个真正的人民政府。
同胞们，这是使中国免于遭受军阀和外国列强双重压迫的唯一可行途径。“打倒利用军阀剥削中国的帝国主义列强！”“打倒协助外国列强压迫中国人民的军阀！”“全中国广大民众中的民族革命者，联合起来！”
